description: Search TestWell's public catalog of cash-pay lab tests and panels by keyword, biomarker, CPT code, or category. Returns name, slug, per-lab prices, sample, fasting, turnaround and order URL. Prices are stickers; every order adds one $6 lab processing fee (see quote_order for all-in totals).

lang.description: Return Spanish names/descriptions where a translation exists (default en)

orderableOnly.description: Exclude items listed as coming soon (default true)

query.description: Keyword, biomarker, CPT code or health goal, e.g. 'vitamin d', 'TSH', '80053', 'cholesterol'

type.description: Restrict to individual tests or bundled panels

name: search_tests

biomarkersNotReportedAt.description: Markers of `biomarkers` that one lab's report for this test does not carry, keyed by lab; present only where it applies. Choose the lab accordingly

consentDocument.description: A document the patient must read and acknowledge at the pay step on test-well.com before this test is ordered; url is a printable copy

siteCheckoutOnly.description: True when the test can only be bought through the checkout on test-well.com (orderUrl), never inside an assistant's own checkout

eligibility.description: Ordering rules set by the lab or the test's maker; present only on tests that have them

labFee.description: Flat per-order lab processing fee (charged once per order)

labTests.description: Panels, in the detail view: for each lab the panel is sold at, the price there and the lab's own tests as ordered on the requisition (the lab's test code or number, and the lab's name for it). The two labs' lists can differ

labs.description: Labs that run it: Quest, Labcorp, BioReference

measuredTurnaround.description: Measured medians from real TestWell orders (specimen at lab → final results), per lab, in days; a pair is published only when it has 30+ completed orders. Sample sizes are not published.

prices.description: Sticker price per lab; null where the lab does not run the item

reportNote.description: How the labs' reports for this test differ, in the medical reviewer's words; present only where they do

title: Search the TestWell catalog
